BMI = weight(kg) ÷ height(m)². WHO ke hisab se 18.5-24.9 normal. Tools me BMI calculator bhi hai. ⚖️
Percentage = (hissa ÷ kul) × 100. Jaise 45 ka 200 me = 45/200×100 = 22.5%.
Simple Interest = (P × R × T) ÷ 100, jahan P mool dhan, R dar % aur T saal.
Compound amount A = P(1 + R/100)^T (saalana). Interest = A − P.
Circle ka area = π × r², parivesh = 2πr (π ≈ 3.14159).
Rectangle = lambai × chaudai, Triangle = ½ × aadhar × oonchai, Square = side², Circle = πr².
Speed = Doori ÷ Samay. Doori = Speed × Samay. Samay = Doori ÷ Speed. 1 km/h = 5/18 m/s.
